evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one music discovery feature; content identification and fingerprinting are alternative methods.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one profile-based music discovery feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one social/music discovery feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one content-similarity discovery feature; music and ringback tones are content type variants.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one metadata/tag-based music discovery feature; listed outcomes are benefits.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one upload workflow whose expected outcome is tag availability downstream.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single video segment viewing feature.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one similar-content information retrieval feature; items and segments are result variants.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one perceptual-similarity information retrieval feature.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one location-based recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines person identification and related-information retrieval, which are independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines product identification and related-information retrieval.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines logo identification and related-information retrieval.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines brand identification and related-information retrieval.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one image-to-video recommendation feature; taking a picture and uploading are alternative inputs.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos
evaluations.rationale: Combines geographic content access and location-based notifications, which are separate features.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one ASR-based search feature.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Combines viewing, validation, and editing, which are distinct segmentation management actions.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines annotation and topic extraction, which are independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Combines filtering and ranking, which are separate quality-related actions.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one audio editing assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one content filtering feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one low-level asset filtering feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one copyright validation feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one high-level metadata/tag filtering feature; input sources are alternatives.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Lists attributes of a single picture assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one prompt detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one volunteer classification feature.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one image preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one image series detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one attribute preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one animal count detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one plankton image analysis feature with alternative methods.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Lists measurement attributes within one plankton detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one motion analysis feature with a stated purpose.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one event detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Lists feature types within one satellite image detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one classification weighting feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one image artifact removal feature; examples are types of artifacts.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one object detection feature; moving and transient are object types.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one audio cleanup feature; noise and distracting sounds are target artifacts.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one whale-call grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one whale count identification feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one interruption timing feature.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one interruption modality decision; modality types are alternatives.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one education timing feature.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one education modality decision; modality types are alternatives.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one education selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one comment detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one comment timing feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one explanation timing feature.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one message content selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one subject grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one project recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one article summary feature; the reuse is a stated purpose.
